alert_tweaks.title: Alert Tweaks
alert_tweaks.page.health.desc: Low-health vignette around the screen and the heartbeat that speeds up as you get closer to dying.
alert_tweaks.page.threat.desc: An arrow around the crosshair pointing at whoever just hit you. The attacker is never highlighted.
alert_tweaks.page.alerts.desc: Cards for what the screen does not tell you at a glance. Each one can be turned off, given its own sound and tested here.
alert_tweaks.page.kohs.desc: Made by Zymekoh. Join the Discord for help, ideas and the other KoHs mods.
alert_tweaks.alert.totem_offhand.desc: Your offhand totem is gone (it popped or you moved it). Tells you how many are left in the inventory.
alert_tweaks.alert.totems_low.desc: Your total totem count drops to the chosen number.
alert_tweaks.alert.enemy_pop.desc: Another player pops a totem: shows who and how many times since they last died.
alert_tweaks.alert.armor_low.desc: A piece you are wearing (elytra included) drops below the chosen durability.
alert_tweaks.alert.held_low.desc: The item in your main hand drops below the chosen durability.
alert_tweaks.alert.shield_disabled.desc: An axe hit put your shield on cooldown.
alert_tweaks.alert.cooldown_ready.desc: Ender pearl, wind charge, chorus fruit or shield can be used again. Short cooldowns are skipped so a normal pearl throw does not ping every time.
alert_tweaks.alert.effect_harmful.desc: You receive a harmful effect (poison, weakness, slowness, wither, levitation...) or a stronger level of one.
alert_tweaks.alert.effect_ending.desc: A good effect (fire resistance, strength, speed...) is about to end.
alert_tweaks.alert.no_sprint.desc: Your food drops to 3 drumsticks, where sprinting stops working.
alert_tweaks.alert.dangerous_fall.desc: While falling, predicts the damage of landing where you are heading: water, slime, hay, beds, Feather Falling, Protection and Resistance are counted.
alert_tweaks.alert.supplies_low.desc: Golden apples, pearls, crystals, obsidian, anchors, glowstone, bottles o' enchanting, wind charges or arrows you were carrying drop to a few.
alert_tweaks.alert.inventory_full.desc: No free slot left: anything new you walk over stays on the ground.
alert_tweaks.alert.server_lag.desc: The server stopped sending its regular update. What you do now may be rolled back. Tells you when it comes back. Multiplayer only.
alert_tweaks.msg.inventory_full_detail: New items stay on the ground
alert_tweaks.gui.vignette.desc: Tints the screen edges when your health drops below the threshold, stronger the closer you are to dying.
alert_tweaks.gui.health.desc: Health where the vignette begins. One heart is 2 health points.
alert_tweaks.gui.color.desc: Click or drag in the bar: hue across, brightness down.
alert_tweaks.gui.size.desc: How far the vignette reaches towards the centre.
alert_tweaks.gui.smooth.desc: Fades in and out instead of snapping.
alert_tweaks.gui.static.desc: Same strength at any health under the threshold.
alert_tweaks.gui.intensity.desc: Strength used while Fixed strength is on.
alert_tweaks.gui.pulse.desc: The vignette beats like a heart.
alert_tweaks.gui.pulse_link.desc: The pulse speeds up and hits harder as your health drops.
alert_tweaks.gui.heartbeat.desc: Plays a heartbeat under the health threshold. Has a subtitle.
alert_tweaks.gui.beat_link.desc: Very low health speeds the heartbeat up and raises its pitch.
alert_tweaks.gui.play.desc: Four beats with the current settings.
alert_tweaks.gui.threat.desc: When a player hits you, an arrow points at them for five seconds and follows them while it lasts.
alert_tweaks.gui.adaptive.desc: Same physical size at any GUI scale. Moving Scale turns it off.
alert_tweaks.gui.distance.desc: How far from the crosshair the arrows sit.
alert_tweaks.gui.simulate_hit.desc: Plays the arrow in the preview from a new direction.
alert_tweaks.gui.sound.desc: Click to try the next sound.
alert_tweaks.gui.test.desc: Shows this card in the preview with its sound.
alert_tweaks.gui.edge_flash.desc: Danger alerts flash the screen edges once in crimson.
alert_tweaks.gui.kohs.note: Alert Tweaks KoHs - made by Zymekoh
alert_tweaks.gui.discord.desc: Help, ideas and news of every KoHs mod.
alert_tweaks.gui.website.desc: Every KoHs mod in one place.
alert_tweaks.page.players.desc: Tell you when the players you name join or leave the server you are on. Read from the server's player list (Tab), never from where anyone is.
alert_tweaks.alert.player_join.desc: Someone on your watch list appears on the server's player list.
alert_tweaks.alert.player_leave.desc: Someone on your watch list is no longer on the server's player list.
alert_tweaks.alert.player_online.desc: When you join a server (or edit your list), one card says who on your list is already there.
alert_tweaks.gui.threat_style.desc: How the indicator looks. Every style shows the same thing: where the hit came from, for five seconds.
alert_tweaks.gui.player_name.desc: Type a name and press Enter or +. Their face comes from Mojang, the same skin NameMC shows; names without an account show a default skin.
alert_tweaks.gui.player_row.desc: The switch pauses this player without removing them; x removes them. A green dot: on this server now.
alert_tweaks.gui.players.note: Players hidden by vanish never show, and nobody's position is ever read.
alert_tweaks.editor.title: Alert positions
alert_tweaks.editor.test.desc: Every switched-on alert pops up where you put it, with the real animation.
alert_tweaks.editor.reset.desc: Every alert back to the default place, under the crosshair.
alert_tweaks.editor.hint: Drag a card or an alert from this list to where it should appear.
alert_tweaks.editor.hint2: Drop it on another card to stack them. Right-click or drop it here: back to default.
alert_tweaks.gui.look.desc: How this alert shows up: card, compact pill, icon only, text only or a wide banner.
alert_tweaks.editor.look_all.desc: Gives every alert the same look at once; each one can still be changed on the Alerts page.
alert_tweaks.editor.tut1: Drag a card to where it should appear
alert_tweaks.editor.tut2: Drop another one on it to stack them
alert_tweaks.editor.tut3: Grab the ... above a stack to move it whole
alert_tweaks.editor.tut4: Right-click a card: back to the default place
alert_tweaks.editor.tut5: That's it! The ? button shows this again
alert_tweaks.editor.tut_skip: Click or press any key to skip
